Image generation returning base64-encoded data instead of URL

```php title="PHP"
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/vendor/autoload.php';

use Liter\Llm\LiterLlm;
use Liter\Llm\CreateImageRequest;
use Liter\Llm\Image;
$result = LiterLlm::imageGenerate(new \Liter\Llm\CreateImageRequest(prompt: "A blue circle",
model: "dall-e-3",
n: 1,
size: "1024x1024",
responseFormat: "b64_json"));
var_dump($result->getData());
var_dump($result->getData()[0]->b64Json);
```
